args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';const read=p=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')),old=read('docs/qualification/2026-10-18-input-rules-browser-installed.json'),installed=read('target/input-rules-current-installed-consumer.json'),current=installed.probes['probe-input-rules-ui'],historical=read('target/input-rules-historical-ci-followup.json');assert.equal(installed.producerRebuildQualified,true);assert.equal(installed.reusedRuntimes,false);assert.equal(installed.proofPolicy.historicalReferences,false);assert.equal(current.earlierWasmSha256,null);assert.equal(current.priorSdkWasmSha256,null);assert.equal(historical.proofPolicy.historicalReferences,true);assert.deepEqual(historical.earlierWasmSha256,old.reports.dom.earlierWasmSha256);assert.deepEqual(historical.priorSdkWasmSha256,old.reports.dom.priorSdkWasmSha256);for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(historical)){if(typeof value!=='number')continue;if(key==='startupRefusals'){assert.equal(value,8);assert.equal(current[key],4);}else if(key==='legacyWholeReplacementRefusals'){assert.equal(value,1);assert.equal(current[key],0);}else assert.equal(current[key],value,key);}for(const key of ['localWasmSha256','sharedWasmSha256']){assert.equal(current[key],historical[key]);assert.equal(current[key],old.reports.dom[key]);}assert.deepEqual(installed.archives.map(({name,sha256})=>({name,sha256})),old.reports.installed.archives.map(({name,sha256})=>({name,sha256})));console.log(JSON.stringify({currentFunctionalCasesUnchanged:true,fullHistoricalProofPreserved:true,currentScopeDeferredHistoricalClasses:current.proofPolicy.deferred,archiveBytesUnchanged:true}));
